description: The colour allow-list of the model colours that reach the markup as an attribute (§3.7a): #rgb, #rrggbb and a named colour from a small fixed safe set. A value outside the list is dropped by the generator (with a warning), never sanitized into something else, because a CSS function or a quote would let a crafted string leave the attribute or fetch a remote resource.

members.name: IsAllowed
members.description: Answers whether a colour may be written into the markup. Empty is not a colour: the caller omits the attribute instead.
